g.text: GPIO2 pulled up in I2C section
Auto-reset circuit based on NodeMCU Dev Kit
SJ1 can be cut to modify the charge- current programming resistor.
SJ3 can be cut to avoid powering a WS2812 string with VCC. In case a higher-power source is required.
SJ2 can be cut to disable the power LED. (Saving lots of power.)
Charge current: I_CHG = 1000 / R_PROG R_PROG=2k : I_CHG=500mA
Si7021 Temperature and Humidity Sensor & I2C Header
V_ADC = V_ADC-IN * 10 / 32 V_ADC-IN = V_ADC * 32/10 e.g.: 3.3V in : 1.03 out
V_BATT should be a single- cell LiPo battery.
SJ4 can be cleared to remove the pull-up resistors from SDA and SCL. (NOTE: GPIO2 _must_ be pulled high to run.)
